break_even_units.description: The first year's fixed costs ÷ (price − variable cost), to 1 decimal; absent when that margin is not above zero.

discounted_payback_years.description: The same with the present values.

irr.description: The internal rate of return nearest 10%, a fraction to 4 decimals; absent when there is none.

margin_of_safety_percent.description: (units − break-even units) ÷ units, the first year's, as a percentage (RND-PERCENT).

examples: A study never posts: nothing here changes the books (FR-PLN-08).

payback_years.description: Years until the running total is no longer below zero, to 1 decimal; absent when it never is in the period.

profitability_index.description: 1 + NPV ÷ investment, to 2 decimals; absent without an investment.

sensitivity.description: The NPV with sales volume and fixed costs each at 80% to 120%.

tax_pack.description: The sg-cit version it came from.

tax_rate.description: sg-cit's headline rate at the study's date, fixed for its years.

verdict.description: feasible: a positive NPV and a payback within the longest acceptable; marginal: a positive NPV, but a longer payback or none; not_feasible: an NPV at or below zero; no_figures: no investment, units or price yet.

examples: Marginal: a positive NPV, but the payback of 4.1 years is longer than 3

years.description: Year 0 to the end of the period.
